MessageTemplate.Text: The RoleUUID '{1}' returned by the roles server for UserUUID '{2}' was not found locally in this application.

Objects.Caption:
The clean up roles activity is placed here because:
1. If it is placed before calling the AppRolesAPI it means that the roles will be cleared even when there is a connection problem with the Roles server.
2. If it is placed after the split (number of roles > 0), then the roles won't be cleared if the number of roles is not more than zero.
This microflow is also called in Java. Be careful about changing input parameters and return values!!
